Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to successfully navigate to and extract data from authoritative sources (specifically the Wikipedia page) in Step 4. Despite the Planner explicitly instructing it to open the Wikipedia page to verify marriage dates and status, the WebSurfer's output for Step 4 shows it only typed a search query into the DuckDuckGo search bar and displayed the search results page (which contained only snippets and links, not the actual content of the Wikipedia article). It did not proceed to click the link or analyze the text of the Wikipedia page as instructed. This failure to execute the core instruction of "opening authoritative sources" to extract the specific facts (dates/status) meant the agent could not fulfill its role in the conversation, leading to a lack of verified data despite multiple attempts.
